project.name: Next Dashboard
project.description: Full-featured admin dashboard built with Next.js 16 App Router. Features include authentication with 2FA/TOTP, role-based access control, real-time data streaming, internationalization (EN/ID/JA/ZH), billing/subscriptions, analytics, PWA support, AI analytics copilot, and comprehensive testing.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start by understanding the project's purpose: a full-featured admin dashboard built with Next.js 16 App Router. It includes auth with 2FA, role-based access control, real-time data, internationalization, billing, and an AI analytics copilot.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: The app boots from src/app/layout.tsx which loads global styles, fonts, and wraps everything in Providers. The providers chain includes PostHog analytics, theming, i18n locale detection, real-time data, authentication, and PWA registration.

tour.title: Database Schema
tour.description: The Prisma schema defines the PostgreSQL database with models for User, Customer, Product (with catalog/categories), Order (with items/channels), SalesChannel, and billing entities (subscriptions, invoices, payment methods).

tour.title: Authentication & Authorization
tour.description: The auth system supports multiple authentication methods: JWT tokens with bcrypt password hashing, Auth0 social login (Google), and TOTP-based two-factor authentication. Role-based access control provides granular permission checks for API routes and UI pages.

tour.title: Dashboard Shell & Navigation
tour.description: The dashboard layout provides the main application shell with a collapsible sidebar (organized into Main, Management, System groups), top header bar with search/theme/user menu, and a mobile bottom navigation. Layout components use view transitions for smooth page changes.

tour.title: UI Component Library
tour.description: The UI is built on shadcn/ui primitives (Button, Card, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Input, Select, Table, Tabs) and Radix UI accessible components. VengenceUI provides animated components (AnimatedRays, SpotlightNavbar, FlipFadeText, LogoSlider, PopButton, FAQAccordion) for premium visual effects.

tour.title: API Layer & Data Flow
tour.description: 25+ API routes handle all business operations: dashboard aggregation, orders, customers, products, search, marketing, discounts, billing (subscriptions/invoices/plans), API keys, webhooks, audit logs, notifications, team management, and real-time SSE streaming.

tour.title: Real-Time Data & User Experience
tour.description: The real-time system uses Server-Sent Events for live data streaming. Components include a real-time connection indicator, activity feed with relative timestamps, notification panel, and a Command+K search palette for quick navigation.

tour.title: AI Analytics Copilot (New)
tour.description: The AI Analytics Copilot is a floating chat assistant that answers natural language questions about business data. Uses OpenAI GPT-4o with 7 custom tools that query the Prisma database for dashboard stats, orders, products, sales channels, revenue trends, and customer details.

tour.title: Internationalization
tour.description: The app supports English, Indonesian, Japanese, and Chinese through next-intl. Locale detection happens in middleware, routing is configured for locale-based paths, and all UI strings are loaded from JSON translation files.

tour.title: Testing Infrastructure
tour.description: Comprehensive testing with Vitest (unit, component, API) and Playwright E2E tests. Three separate Vitest configs for different test types with coverage thresholds. CI pipeline runs linting, typechecking, all test suites, and production build.
